places.name: London
places.significance: Capital of the United Kingdom, and of England, on the Thames
notes: The UK is the sovereign country, recognised like India, China or the USA — not Great Britain, and not its individual countries (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland)
Great Britain is England, Scotland and Wales; the United Kingdom adds Northern Ireland
The UK comprises four constituent countries, which have their own capital and parliament (except England) and varying degrees of devolved self-government — but ultimate sovereignty rests with the UK
